block.title: In-game enemy sprite sheet: skeet, vane, tender
block.positive: 16-bit SNES-era video game sprite sheet, pixel art style, bold dark navy outlines, saturated limited palette, laid out in a clean grid on a flat deep navy background color reference hex 0c1a3c, no gradients, no shadows under sprites, no text, no labels, no UI. Row one: four animation frames of a SKEET pod, a small seed-shaped armored drone, matte gunmetal shell with rust-violet panel seams and a single magenta eye-slit, shown with hatches closed, hatches cracking, hatches fully open releasing a pink bullet orb with bright core and dark rim, and damaged with one fin sheared. Row two: four frames of a VANE bladed flier, a steel chassis with three crescent-mirror wingblades rotating in 90-degree steps, blades showing a lilac glint edge. Row three: two frames of a large TENDER carrier drone, a wide flat-bellied gunmetal mothership pod with green running lights and an open underside bay door revealing glow of stored skeet pods inside, plus two frames of a small released escort drone. Crisp chunky pixels, consistent scale per row, side-view arcade shoot-'em-up orientation facing left.
